description: Hydrodynamique et transport en suspension du matériel particulaire fin dans la zone fluviale d’un estuaire macrotidal : l’exemple de l’estuaire de la Seine (France) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. The Seine, a river with an oceanic storm regime and low flow, leads to the plateau continental North-West Europe. Its estuary, of macrotidal type, is strongly channeled and anthropized. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Hydrodynamics and suspended transport of fine particulate matter in the riverine zone of a macrotidal estuary: the examp" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Land cover, Cadastral parcels, Protected sites, Atmospheric conditions, Hydrography, Sea regions. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
